topNews.text: Iconic Kruger National Park Celebrates 100th Year of Protecting African Wildlife, Including the Big 5
topNews.excerpt: On Sunday, South African authorities and nature lovers alike celebrated the centenary of Kruger National Park—a 7,500-square-mile paradise of African wildlife, and a cornerstone of the nation’s conservation efforts. topNews.text: Australia Becomes 30th Country to Eliminate Trachoma, Leading Cause of Infectious Blindness
